question.question: Give Eyrie standard starting placements, leader/Vizier procedure and remaining roost arrangement.

expected.expected_answer: 20 warrior supply; roost and six warriors in corner not another starting corner, diagonally opposite starting corner if possible. Choose leader, others face up; Viziers in indicated columns. Six remaining roosts track right to left.

source_passages.quotation: **Eyrie setup (7.3):** Supply 20 warriors. Put one roost and six warriors in a corner that is not another player's starting corner, diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible. Choose a leader; keep others face up nearby. Tuck the two bird Loyal Viziers into the columns listed on that leader. Fill roost track with the other six roosts from right to left.

answer.ruling: Supply 20 Eyrie warriors. In a corner that is not another player’s starting corner, place one roost and six warriors; choose a corner diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible. Place the other six roosts on the roost track from right to left.
Choose one leader and keep the others face up nearby. Tuck the two bird Loyal Viziers into the columns listed on the chosen leader.
